method: Hand-labelled on 2026-10-30 by reading the retrieval top-5 for each challenge (eval/sheet.md) and marking every researcher whose stated fields, keywords or open-to statements credibly address the challenge's specific need. Labels are ours, not ground truth; the sheet and this file are committed so a reviewer can disagree and recompute. Gold sets are capped at the retrieved top-5, so this measures ranking quality, not recall over 1,047 researchers.
